authorization_and_status_acceptance.connector_projection: Every bootstrap connector now projects state, last_checked_at, latency_ms, last_message_zh, error code, and Chinese next action. A fresh live probe wins over stale persisted health; a probe exception is converted to degraded HEALTH_<exception> rather than failing bootstrap.
authorization_and_status_acceptance.destination_projection: Destination cards use the existing real probe fields and now render last-check time plus latency. The API continues to project destination_receipt rows independently from jobs.
authorization_and_status_acceptance.runtime_journal: connector_state gained only additive nullable metadata columns. Existing databases migrate through PRAGMA table_info checks; no data reset or destructive schema action occurs.
authorization_and_status_acceptance.error_boundary: A connector health exception produces an actionable degraded projection and leaves the authorization/home surface renderable. The focused test proves persisted healthy state cannot mask a current blocked-environment live probe.

task_and_receipt_acceptance.failure_visibility: The side-panel projects failed destination receipts as independently visible export tasks with the receipt message, destination, and retry action.
task_and_receipt_acceptance.retry_contract: POST /v1/destinations/receipts/{receipt_id}/retry requeues its terminal origin job where available. If only a stable export job can be found, it reuses it safely; queued, running, and completed jobs are not falsely reported as new retries.
task_and_receipt_acceptance.traceability: The failed receipt remains queryable after retry while its original job is queued. This preserves the failure audit trail instead of replacing it with a synthetic success receipt.
task_and_receipt_acceptance.duplicate_retry_guard: POST /v1/jobs/{job_id}/retry rejects queued, running, and completed jobs with HTTP 409, preventing a stale/double click from claiming another retry.

three_replica_completion_acceptance.rule: The settings page reads bootstrap.storage.completion and only labels archive completion when pending is zero. Any incomplete replica state shows the explicit Chinese 3/3-not-complete message.
